scope: Source findings and required changes; risks without reproduction are not asserted incidents; no implementation or fixes claimed.

issues.finding: Face initialization/tracking depends on Reachy connection and movement manager
issues.planned_resolution: Independent face detection/temporal state with no SDK/daemon
Separate listening and turn processing; one cancellation authority and release checks
Bound time/bytes, define overflow, verify slow-consumer and cancellation

issues.finding: Startup helpers may terminate unrelated device/audio holders
issues.planned_resolution: Own-resource cleanup only; report external occupancy
issues.remaining: Physical process/device failure matrix still requires R3/R4 evidence.

issues.planned_resolution: Chinese ASR/TTS adapters and short-utterance/segmentation checks

issues.finding: Exact wheel manifest L4T39.2.0 differs from local39.2.1
issues.planned_resolution: Isolated compatibility verification or documented host build

issues.finding: Body/hand small-model pipeline and human wave/static palm events not present in reviewed source
issues.planned_resolution: Add bounded perception and deterministic two-gesture rules

issues.finding: Broad exception handling and forced process exit in main entry
issues.planned_resolution: Observable errors, scoped orderly cleanup and repeat lifecycle checks

issues.finding: Upstream default model and multi-frame input differ from selected4B/2K profile
issues.planned_resolution: Verify model identity, native token budget and declared image policy

issues.finding: Current-session semantics and optional durable tools need explicit integration
issues.planned_resolution: One context owner, minimal optional actions and cancellation-safe receipts

issues.finding: Old RealSense depth startup warning appeared after switching from V4L2 RGB back to ROS; active service was not enough to prove restoration.
issues.planned_resolution: Require fresh color and aligned depth after each migration handover; record recovery, never infer readiness from PID only.

issues.finding: Palm example supplies xyxy boxes to OpenCV xywh NMS; two disjoint boxes can be merged.
TensorRT engine emits device-compatibility warning after reboot; recorded hardware fields match build, similar upstream issue exists.
Initial tool integration flattened function calls/results out of history; actual reminder query then fabricated an ID and task without a database call.
issues.planned_resolution: Retain whole native tool groups, require fresh queries and preserve actual transaction receipts.

issues.finding: A paused loop retained 10000 scheduled callbacks for 10000 frames despite a bounded client queue; six simultaneous handshakes bypassed the four-client limit.
issues.planned_resolution: One scheduled drain with byte/event budgets, pre-accept reservations, bounded body/native read/send ownership and turn-keyed snapshot initialization.

issues.finding: Per-read HTTP timeouts are refreshed by each small chunk, so configured model timeout did not bound total request duration; real local response completed after 0.413s with 0.08s per-read timeout.
issues.planned_resolution: Own one absolute-deadline timer per inference operation, interrupt only its socket, join timer before releasing local admission, retain separate native release checks.

issues.finding: Old LLM health_check accepted HTTP 200 even when the returned model alias differed from the configured alias.
Actual RGB driver detach terminated the capture thread; rebind restored the device node but not capture.
New microphone utterances were rejected while the old turn ran, rather than entering the cancellation/release path.

hardware_gap.microphone: ReSpeaker Lite dual-mic, not connected per user
hardware_gap.speaker: not connected per user
hardware_gap.rule: Physical audio explicitly deferred by user on 2026-10-16; does not block B0-SW and vision-first handoff. File/PCM substitutes do not qualify acoustics.
